newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NZ rugby player's S.African rape trial set for June.
newsitem.headline: NZ rugby player's S.African rape trial set for June.

text.p: A New Zealand rugby player charged with rape in South Africa will go on trial in June, a magistrate said on Monday.

Roger Randle, the 22-year-old winger for the Wellington Hurricanes of the Super 12 professional league, allegedly raped a 31-year-old woman in the Indian Ocean port city of Durban in the early hours of Saturday morning.

Magistrate Stanley Gumede said at the brief court appearance that Randle, who was released on 5,000 rand ($1,136) bail on Saturday evening, could leave the country provided he returned to face trial on June 11 to 13. Randle was not asked to plead.
Randle's lawyer gave the court a written undertaking by the New Zealand Rugby Union that he would return to South Africa.
